content.text:
Submitted.

**Sole repair in this pass:** the inserted clause now carries its number in the operative text — "10.5 License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business." — so the §17.2 carve-out ("except as expressly licensed to Customer under Section 10.5") points to a clause that actually exists. That closes the dangling cross-reference and makes the conforming carve-out effective, so §17.2's Term-limited "no rights" acknowledgement no longer contradicts the perpetual, irrevocable grant.

Everything else is unchanged and verified at `ok:true` with minimality satisfied: three operations, one per limb of the cure; §10.4's ownership sentence and refund/credit mechanic, §17.1's sole-ownership sentence, and the mutual confidentiality standard in §17.4 all preserved verbatim, with only the M&I Customer Data proviso added. Position remains at the IP fallback; preferred (Customer ownership/assignment of work product) is not met and is flagged as a level selection, not an omission.
